answer: Locks are written down in pearl, expire in haven, and falcon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 41 aliases therefore needs 98 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4537 identities would post 867 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
